community_note.text: The Third Recalibration Accords of 2841 standardized deep-field mass measurements for objects beyond 50 kiloparsecs. NGC-17, located approximately 2.3 kiloparsecs from the galactic midplane, falls within the hybrid-measurement zone where both Sol-unit and Vega-Equivalent notation remain in accepted use per IAU-3026 guidelines [1]. The claim that Sol units 'haven't been used in formal literature since 2841' is not supported by current standards. [1] IAU Joint Measurement Standards Committee, Bulletin 3025-C, §4.2
